about.title: Well, hi again!
about.intro: I am Lorenzo, a software engineer and Master's student at the University of Oradea. I currently work as a Senior Software Engineer, helping companies design, build, and promote digital products.
about.freelance: Alongside my professional role, I take on freelance work and personal projects, where I experiment with ideas and refine my approach to modern web development.
about.interests: My interests include web development, creative coding, and interactive design, with a strong focus on building fast, responsive interfaces and smooth user experiences.
about.career: Throughout my career, I have mainly worked with frontend technologies. I prefer React and Next.js, which I use to build scalable, high-performance web applications.
